hero.title: From quote to paid. Every step tracked.
hero.description: Full lifecycle order management with line items, payment tracking, and auto-stock adjustments — so nothing falls through the cracks.

intro: Orders in VOIS are the central record connecting CRM clients, products with variants, and inventory. When a booking completes or a job finishes, an order is auto-created with the correct line items and pricing. Payment status flows from unpaid to partially paid to paid to refunded — always visible, always current. Every line item deducts from product inventory in real time, eliminating manual stock counts entirely.

lineItems.heading: Line Items — Order #1247 · Henderson Renovation
lineItems.annotation: Orders auto-created from bookings and jobs. Line items pull from your product catalogue with variant support.

benefitCards.title: Auto-created from bookings
benefitCards.desc: When a booking completes, the order generates automatically with correct line items and pricing. No duplicate data entry, no missed charges.

benefitCards.title: Live stock adjustments
benefitCards.desc: Each order line item deducts from product inventory in real time. No manual stock counts. Reorder alerts trigger before you run out.

benefitCards.title: Payment lifecycle
benefitCards.desc: Track unpaid → partial → paid → refunded. Every status change is logged and connected to your accounting platform automatically.

scenario: A plumber finishes a job. On the drive back, he tells VOIS what parts he used — two ball valves, a flex hose, and three hours of labour.
scenarioHighlight: VOIS auto-creates the order with the correct line items, deducts the parts from inventory, links the order to the CRM client, and prepares the invoice — before he's back at the office.
